title: [Shopify] Keep exchange shipments eligible for synchronization
summary: Exchange-refund Shopify orders now sync their shipments correctly. A bug where the refund ID was incorrectly copied to the fulfillment ID field during shipment posting has been fixed.
key_points: Refund ID was unintentionally copied to the fulfillment ID during shipment posting via TransferFields
This caused shipments to be treated as already synchronized, preventing proper sync to Shopify
The fix clears the fulfillment value when it matches a transferred refund ID
Exchange-refund orders can now synchronize their shipments with Shopify
Low risk change with no schema modifications
quote: Clear the fulfillment value when it was transferred from the source refund ID, while preserving the Shopify order identifiers.
